partially_covered.missing: No explicit property or class for displaying organization information beyond address and identifier; lacks organization name, contact details, and other metadata.
Item information limited to name and description; lacks properties for item codes, units of measure, and classification.
Validation rules and SHACL constraints are present structurally, but mandatory fields per D96A directory are not explicitly modeled or enforced.

cq_coverage.details: Most CQs are structurally supported via class and property definitions, especially for message, role, item, and invoice queries. Some CQs lack detail on organization and item metadata, and validation constraints are not fully explicit for mandatory fields.

strengths: Deep and rich hierarchy for EDIFACT structures and roles
Good use of property characteristics (functional, inverses)
Advanced constructs with owl:equivalentClass and restrictions
weaknesses: Limited coverage of organization and item metadata
Disjointness could be further refined for technical elements

likely_oops_pitfalls: P4 (Missing domain or range for some properties)
P7 (Missing value for some annotation properties in edge cases)
reasoner_risks: Hermit may struggle with deep inverse chains and complex restrictions if extended
No datatype violations detected; should be reasoner-safe

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Expand organization metadata: add properties for organization name, contact info, and legal identifiers. Model mandatory fields for D96A directory explicitly and enforce via SHACL constraints.
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Full coverage for CQ5, CQ13, and improved interoperability.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add general class axioms (GCAs) to define complex business logic, e.g., for validating that sum of invoice lines matches invoice amount. Use owl:hasKey for reference numbers.
Expand item modeling: add item codes, units of measure, and classification properties (e.g., product category).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Improved coverage for CQ8 and support for industrial procurement scenarios.

improvement_suggestions.suggestion: Add EDIFACT segment code mappings and technical annotations for segments and elements (e.g., BGM, NAD, LIN).
improvement_suggestions.expected_impact: Better alignment with EDIFACT and easier technical integration.

summary: The ontology provides strong structural coverage for EDIFACT invoice scenarios and most competency questions, with good hierarchy and use of OWL 2 constructs. Some organization and item metadata are missing, and validation rules for mandatory fields need to be more explicit. Overall, it is a solid foundation that can be improved by enriching metadata, adding GCAs, and expanding technical vocabulary.
